item.title: Faith Inspire hosts successful Winter Family Event at London Muslim Centre
item.description: Faith Inspire marked the start of the school holidays by hosting its annual Winter Family Event on Saturday 20 December at the London Muslim Centre (LMC), drawing more than 300 attendees from across the local community. The day-long event took place across two floors of the centre, offering a wide range of activities for families and children.
